paragraphs.text: translated by
1. THE Heavens and the Earth accordant with all Gods encouraged graciously that vigorous might of his.
paragraphs.original: तमस्य द्यावापृथिवी सचेतसा विश्वेभिर्देवैरनु शुष्ममावताम् ।
paragraphs.translit: tamasya dyāvāpṛthivī sacetasā viśvebhirdevairanu śuṣmamāvatām |

paragraphs.text: When he came showing forth his majesty and power, he drank of Soma juice and waxed exceeding strong.
paragraphs.original: यदैत्कृण्वानो महिमानमिन्द्रियं पीत्वी सोमस्य क्रतुमाँ अवर्धत
paragraphs.translit: yadaitkṛṇvāno mahimānamindriyaṃ pītvī somasya kratumām̐ avardhata

paragraphs.text: 2. This majesty of his Visnu extols and lauds, making the state that gives the meath flow forth with might.
paragraphs.original: तमस्य विष्णुर्महिमानमोजसांशुं दधन्वान्मधुनो वि रप्शते ।
paragraphs.translit: tamasya viṣṇurmahimānamojasāṃśuṃ dadhanvānmadhuno vi rapśate |

paragraphs.text: When Indra Maghavan with those who followed him had smitten Vrtra he deserved the choice of Gods.
paragraphs.original: देवेभिरिन्द्रो मघवा सयावभिर्वृत्रं जघन्वाँ अभवद्वरेण्यः
paragraphs.translit: devebhirindro maghavā sayāvabhirvṛtraṃ jaghanvām̐ abhavadvareṇyaḥ

paragraphs.text: 3. When, bearing warlike weapons, fain to win thee praise, thou meetest Vrtra, yea, the Dragon, for the fight,
paragraphs.original: वृत्रेण यदहिना बिभ्रदायुधा समस्थिथा युधये शंसमाविदे ।
paragraphs.translit: vṛtreṇa yadahinā bibhradāyudhā samasthithā yudhaye śaṃsamāvide |

paragraphs.text: Then all the Maruts who were gathered with dice there extolled, O Mighty One, thy powerful majesty.
paragraphs.original: विश्वे ते अत्र मरुतः सह त्मनावर्धन्नुग्र महिमानमिन्द्रियम्
paragraphs.translit: viśve te atra marutaḥ saha tmanāvardhannugra mahimānamindriyam

paragraphs.text: 4. Soon as he sprang to life he forced asunder hosts: forward the Hero looked to manly deed and war.
paragraphs.original: जज्ञान एव व्यबाधत स्पृधः प्रापश्यद्वीरो अभि पौंस्यं रणम् ।
paragraphs.translit: jajñāna eva vyabādhata spṛdhaḥ prāpaśyadvīro abhi pauṃsyaṃ raṇam |

paragraphs.text: He cleft the rock, he let concurrent streams flow forth, and with his skillful art stablished the heavens' wide vault.
paragraphs.original: अवृश्चदद्रिमव सस्यदः सृजदस्तभ्नान्नाकं स्वपस्यया पृथुम्
paragraphs.translit: avṛścadadrimava sasyadaḥ sṛjadastabhnānnākaṃ svapasyayā pṛthum

paragraphs.text: 5. Indra hath evermore possessed surpassing power: he forced, far from each other, heaven and earth apart.
paragraphs.original: आदिन्द्रः सत्रा तविषीरपत्यत वरीयो द्यावापृथिवी अबाधत ।
paragraphs.translit: ādindraḥ satrā taviṣīrapatyata varīyo dyāvāpṛthivī abādhata |

paragraphs.text: He hurled impetuous down his iron thunderbolt, a joy to Varuna's and Mitra's worshipper.
paragraphs.original: अवाभरद्धृषितो वज्रमायसं शेवं मित्राय वरुणाय दाशुषे
paragraphs.translit: avābharaddhṛṣito vajramāyasaṃ śevaṃ mitrāya varuṇāya dāśuṣe

paragraphs.text: 6. Then to the mighty powers of Indra, to his wrath, his the fierce Stormer, loud of voice, they came with speed;
paragraphs.original: इन्द्रस्यात्र तविषीभ्यो विरप्शिन ऋघायतो अरंहयन्त मन्यवे ।
paragraphs.translit: indrasyātra taviṣībhyo virapśina ṛghāyato araṃhayanta manyave |

paragraphs.text: What time the Potent One rent Vrtra with his strength, who held the waters back, whom darkness compassed round.
paragraphs.original: वृत्रं यदुग्रो व्यवृश्चदोजसापो बिभ्रतं तमसा परीवृतम्
paragraphs.translit: vṛtraṃ yadugro vyavṛścadojasāpo bibhrataṃ tamasā parīvṛtam

paragraphs.text: 7. Even in the first of those heroic acts which they who strove together came with might to execute,
paragraphs.original: या वीर्याणि प्रथमानि कर्त्वा महित्वेभिर्यतमानौ समीयतुः ।
paragraphs.translit: yā vīryāṇi prathamāni kartvā mahitvebhiryatamānau samīyatuḥ |

paragraphs.text: Deep darkness fell upon the slain, and Indra won by victory the right of being first invoked.
paragraphs.original: ध्वान्तं तमोऽव दध्वसे हत इन्द्रो मह्ना पूर्वहूतावपत्यत
paragraphs.translit: dhvāntaṃ tamo'va dadhvase hata indro mahnā pūrvahūtāvapatyata

paragraphs.text: 8. Then all the Gods extolled, with eloquence inspired by draughts of Soma juice, thy deeds of manly might.
paragraphs.original: विश्वे देवासो अध वृष्ण्यानि तेऽवर्धयन्सोमवत्या वचस्यया ।
paragraphs.translit: viśve devāso adha vṛṣṇyāni te'vardhayansomavatyā vacasyayā |

paragraphs.text: As Agni eats the dry food with his tongue, he ate Vrtra, the Dragon, maimed by Indra's deadly dart.
paragraphs.original: रद्धं वृत्रमहिमिन्द्रस्य हन्मनाग्निर्न जम्भैस्तृष्वन्नमावयत्
paragraphs.translit: raddhaṃ vṛtramahimindrasya hanmanāgnirna jambhaistṛṣvannamāvayat

paragraphs.text: 9. Proclaim his many friendships, met with friendship, made with singers, with the skillful and the eloquent.
paragraphs.original: भूरि दक्षेभिर्वचनेभिरृक्वभिः सख्येभिः सख्यानि प्र वोचत ।
paragraphs.translit: bhūri dakṣebhirvacanebhirṛkvabhiḥ sakhyebhiḥ sakhyāni pra vocata |

paragraphs.text: Indra, when he subdues Dhuni and Cumuri, lists to Dabhiti for his faithful spirit's sake.
paragraphs.original: इन्द्रो धुनिं च चुमुरिं च दम्भयञ्छ्रद्धामनस्या शृणुते दभीतये
paragraphs.translit: indro dhuniṃ ca cumuriṃ ca dambhayañchraddhāmanasyā śṛṇute dabhītaye

paragraphs.text: 10. Give riches manifold with noble horses, to be remembered while my songs address thee.
paragraphs.original: त्वं पुरूण्या भरा स्वश्व्या येभिर्मंसै निवचनानि शंसन् ।
paragraphs.translit: tvaṃ purūṇyā bharā svaśvyā yebhirmaṃsai nivacanāni śaṃsan |

paragraphs.text: May we by easy paths pass all our troubles: find us this day a ford wide and extensive.
paragraphs.original: सुगेभिर्विश्वा दुरिता तरेम विदो षु ण उर्विया गाधमद्य
paragraphs.translit: sugebhirviśvā duritā tarema vido ṣu ṇa urviyā gādhamadya
